_doc: BUILD-POCKET carve-out (pipeline-mgmt 2026-11-20, D9 standing AK ack). A CPU multi-quarter(3) row (all of q0-q2) whose hold exceeds long_hold_s and that does not declare whole_host_need leaves a pocket for short build claims: (a) it is not granted while a build claim waits; (b) a resumable one is granted with a hard end at max_hold_s (capcut-requeued, so the pocket opens at each cut). A build-wait record counts only with a live (non-zombie) pid and for min(waiter_ttl_s, waiter_ttl_cap_s) unless refreshed. Override any key in <flags>/allocator.json under "build_pocket".
